q17.

The frontend module containing the memo CRUD mutations/queries is **`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`**; it uses the generated service client **`MemoService`** (from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`), instantiated as `memoServiceClient` in `web/src/connect.ts` at line 197.

The CRUD operations are:
- Create: `useCreateMemo()` (line 178)
- Read: `useMemo()` (line 142) and `useMemos()`/`useInfiniteMemos()` (lines 112, 122)
- Update: `useUpdateMemo()` (line 197)
- Delete: `useDeleteMemo()` (line 253)

All call `memoServiceClient` methods (`createMemo`, `getMemo`, `listMemos`, `updateMemo`, `deleteMemo`) which are generated from the MemoService protobuf definition.
